framework: SOC 2 Type II — Helix Robotics scope

controls.title: Logical and Physical Access Controls
controls.description: Logical access security measures restrict access to information assets to authorized personnel. MFA is enforced for all privileged access to the AWS console and Okta.

subcontrols.title: MFA enforcement on AWS console and Okta admin
Quarterly access reviews tracked in Vanta

controls.title: New User Registration and Authorization
controls.description: New user accounts require manager approval via Okta Workflows. Offboarding deprovisioning completes within 24 hours of the HR event.

subcontrols.title: Weekly orphaned-account audit script in payments-api/scripts/

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.description: Security monitoring covers authentication anomalies, privilege escalation, and data exfiltration indicators. Sigma rules are deployed to the Elastic SIEM. Alerting SLA is 15 minutes for P1 events.

controls.title: Vendor and Business Partner Risk
controls.description: Third-party vendors with access to production data undergo annual security assessments. Stripe (payment processor) and AWS are the primary critical vendors.

subcontrols.title: AWS Shared Responsibility Model documentation maintained
